note: The sweep from the closed guard, as in the reference footage (8611719, 18 to 25 s): the posture broken first, then the two of them go over together. top: the man sweeping, who ends on top; bot: the man swept. He pulls the man's head down with the legs still locked and the man posts his hands on the mat; then he turns onto his side, traps an arm and bumps; the man swept tips over his shoulder, his legs coming up, and lands on his back; the sweeper follows him over, low, chest onto his chest, and only then comes up into his guard. Neither comes upright mid-sweep (the first version had the man swept pushed back up onto his knees, inside the sweeper).

keys.note: posture broken: pulled down, hands posted on the mat; the sweeper curled up under him
the sweeper on his side, a hand posted behind him, the legs open; the man swept still folded but tipping, the high-side leg coming off the mat

over: the man swept on his side going onto his back, a hand out on the mat to break the fall, the legs folded together and coming up, the knees forward (not spread: spread and folded tight, with the elbows out, he went over like a spider); the sweeper coming over onto him, low
on top, chest down on his chest, the hands down on him; he's on his back, the legs up round him

place.note: the two of them change places along the line; mid-sweep the man going over is kept ahead of the sweeper coming after him (x: along the line the way the sweeper faces at the end), not level with him: level, their hips passed through each other

deny.note: stopped as he bumps: the man on top posts his hand out wide and rebases, square over him again; the sweeper is flattened back down
